code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with relative lymphopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. There is also mild hypoproteinemia and borderline low glucose. These findings may indicate chronic disease, possible infection or inflammation, and impaired bone marrow function. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended, especially regarding respiratory status and hematologic abnormalities.
